controlsTouch.TREX_RUNNER: Tap to jump. Nothing here is scored.
controlsTouch.TIC_TAC_TOE: Tap a square to play. Nothing here is scored.
controlsTouch.MEMORY_MATCH: Tap two cards to find a pair. The fewer moves it takes, the closer you get to a perfect eight-move round — which is all the score is, and it counts towards nothing.
controlsTouch.CUB_N_PUP: Drag the cub along the links to the star. Drag anywhere else to turn the whole grid. Boards you solve are counted, and the count goes nowhere.
controlsTouch.SNAKE: Swipe to steer. Nothing here is scored.
controlsTouch.SPROUT: Press and drag the can over the soil. Keep the level inside the green band — too much water is as bad as too little. Nothing here is scored towards the course.

lastScore.MEMORY_MATCH: This round: {{score}}% of a perfect round

game.optional: Play as long as you like, or skip straight on — either way you're good to continue.

CUB_N_PUP.hintDragToStar: Drag the cub to the star.
CUB_N_PUP.hintRotate: Drag anywhere else to turn the grid. The cub and the star turn with it — grey links stay put.
CUB_N_PUP.hintFree: Blue links turn with the grid. Turn it to join blue and grey links up in different ways.
CUB_N_PUP.hintPivot: Green links swing round with the grid but keep pointing the same way.
CUB_N_PUP.hintRotateLink: Red links stay where they are but spin with the grid.

SPROUT.hintStart: Hold the can over the soil. Keep the water level inside the green band — too much is as bad as too little.
SPROUT.aimLeaves: Aiming at the leaves. Water on the leaves does not reach the roots.
SPROUT.stateDry: Thirsty. The soil has dried out and growing has stopped.
SPROUT.stateWet: Too wet. The saucer is flooding — ease off and let it drink.
SPROUT.leafDropped: A leaf yellowed and dropped from the wet soil.
SPROUT.leafScorched: Water sat on a leaf in full sun and scorched it.
SPROUT.bloomed: It bloomed. {{blooms}} so far this sitting.
